title: Memorable day in Barcelona
text: Truly a magical day, and I could go on and on. Marc picked us up promptly right in time. Then a scenic informative drive to the stables. Rode horses thru a beautiful vineyard and then to the Albeit winery. Delicious tapas and wine tasting.
author: john w

title: What a GREAT and relaxing tour!
text: My wife and I set out on a dream vacation to Europe. Our final 2 weeks were spent in Barcelona. Through our travel agent, we had randomly selected a vineyard tour on horseback followed by a winery tour and wine tasting with Barcelona By Road. Our driver, Marc, picked us up from our hotel near Placa de Catalunya promptly on schedule. He proceeded to drive us out into wine country. Along the way, he pointed out various points of interest and explained their significance in history or culture. He was a very engaging and infectous conversationalist and we could sense the deep pride he has for his
author: 667mikp

title: Don't wait, just book it.
text: Highly recommend to book a tour with Marc. This was by far the best activity we have done in the Barcelona area. Marc organized a Horseback riding tour and a vinary tour including local sourced lunch, which was absolutely fantastic. Marc took amazing care of us and we could sit back and relax the whole time.
author: B6467RLjuliah

title: Best excursion!
text: Best way to experience the vineyards with amazing guides! Everyone was friendly and helpful. Would recommend!!
author: Emaline_M

title: Amazing Experience
text: Such an amazing experience!! Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. Would recommend for anyone wanting a unique and fun experience through the vineyards!
author: emmim381

title: Highly recommended
text: Horseback raising was amazing, beautiful and the guide was really helpful. Adapted to all levels of ability. Laia, the winery and tapas guide was the best! So kind, helpful and full of knowledge. We really enjoyed this visit!
author: Mary_G

title: Perfect rural getaway for two ❤️
text:
This horseback ride and wine tasting tour was a present for my husband’s birthday and we both absolutely loved it!

Marc was great and very helpful since day one when i contacted him to get some extra information. He picked us from the house and drove us all the way to the Penedes wine region where we did our horse riding in the country - beautiful - and then wine tasting at a lovely ecologic winery nearby. The wine guide was amazing too, we just walked around the vineyards drinking wine and talking about wine. A simple catalán lunch was served for us in a gorgeous setting in a beautiful garde
author: Moshni
